question: Where is the nearest museum located between Kettle Creek Environmental Education Center, Stroudsburg, PA and the Historic Greeley Inn, Greeley, PA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.29615 40.988615)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.001323 41.431334)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'museum'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.29615 40.988615)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.29615 40.988615)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Kettle Creek Environmental Education Center, Stroudsburg, PA

[3].display_name: The Historic Greeley Inn, Greeley, PA
